name: modus
description: Carries a work item through to working behavior and judges when it is finished, with guidance on tests, checks, refactoring, and review

interface.shortDescription: Know when a work item is finished
interface.longDescription: Carries the requested outcome through to working behavior, deciding what remains necessary from the request, the repository, and observed results. Covers what makes a test evidence, when to trust an executable check, when refactoring earns its place, and when a review has found enough to stop.
capabilities: Judge when requested work is finished
Write tests that distinguish correct from incorrect
Stop a review without leaving defects unresolved
defaultPrompt: Implement this work item and tell me when it is actually done.
Is this finished, or is there a real gap left?
